name: Spaghetti Rails
decision: retain the existing racing-item layout and win-based reward

checks.checkLevels: preceding Torchlight build remains valid; no gameplay changes

limitations: The complete eight-rider native race uses production race inputs with no injected miss, death or reset. It is separate from staged placement, spring, downhill and browser recovery checks.

Every item is checked for native rail alignment or supported deck anchoring after accounting for the existing 0.9m racing hover. Dynamic item pickup/use/refill is sampled on all six height tiers; no continuous collection of all 706 items is claimed or required for this win-based race.
Browser opening uses production race controls. Browser fall and finish checks use explicit staged setup; the screenshots are three separately staged full-render views.
The generic adventure-crate audit intentionally excludes this race. Direct runtime checks establish the inventory and mode-specific progression instead.
